messages:
elaine: Quick sync — need to lock down prod-entry criteria for the v1 GA. Items: SLAs/SLOs, docs minimum, support coverage, monitoring/alerts, pricing SKUs, and rollout/canary. Can everyone scan and call out blockers? TL;DR proposal: target p99 < 250ms for hosted text-gen, availability 99.9% monthly, 24/7 triage for first 90 days. Proposal notes: https://redwood-internal/notes/ga-entry-proposal

devin: p99 <250ms is realistic for hosted small/med models but not for all private/dedicated configs. We should publish a per-deployment SLO matrix (hosted/dedicated/private) + expected variance by seq len. Also recommend 5% canary for 7 days before full rollout.

samir: +1 on matrix. Draft suggestion: hosted -> p95 <120ms, p99 <350ms (depends on seq dist); dedicated -> SLA negotiable by reserved capacity; private -> operator-managed SLA. Error budget policy: 10% monthly. Paging rules: latency_p99 > 400ms OR error_rate > 0.5% -> page oncall. I'll add runbooks and automated paging hooks.

olivia: For Support: we can cover 24/7 triage (L2/L3) for the initial 90 days post-GA with oncall rotations. Need training runbook and a customer-facing SLA summary. Who will own the external SLA text?

maria: I'll take docs min checklist. Proposed minimum: API reference, quickstart samples, troubleshooting guide (top 10 errors), rate limits & quotas, rollback/runbook, changelog, and known limitations. ETA 5 working days if owners give input now. Will include code examples and a "how we calculate p99" appendix.

ryan: Pricing/finance: propose SKU set: Hosted-Standard, Hosted-Premium, Dedicated-Reserved, Private-Enterprise. Need feature gates per SKU and rough unit economics. Also need a billing test harness by EOD Friday to validate metering. Will stub initial list and share.

elaine: Decision candidates right now: 1) adopt SLO matrix (eng + sre to draft) 2) 24/7 triage for first 90 days 3) docs minimum owned by docs 4) pricing SKUs draft by finance 5) rollout plan: 5% canary x7 days. Any objections or major blockers?

devin: One more: quantized / memory-optimized variants will change latency distribution. We should add a "model variant fallback" policy in the rollout: if a variant causes >2x error budget burn in 24h, automatic fallback to prior variant.

samir: Noted. I'll implement the fallback circuit breaker and add a metric to the canary dashboard that compares variant latency and error delta.

olivia: For escalations: we need a customer-facing SLA page (simple bullets) + an internal escalation matrix (who to page at each severity). I can own the customer comms and the external wording.

maria: I'll include examples: "How we calculate p99", sample billing examples for a 1M token month, and a prominent known limitations banner (e.g., sequence length >4k may see degraded p99).

elaine: Great — action owners recap: devin -> SLO matrix + canary plan; samir -> alerts, runbooks, fallback automation; maria -> GA docs checklist + examples; ryan -> pricing SKUs + billing tests; olivia -> support & external comms. I'll consolidate the acceptance criteria and circulate final doc by EOD tomorrow.

release-bot: New doc created: https://docs.redwood/internal/ga-entry-criteria (created by elaine)

devin: Quick legal note — enterprise SLA needs legal signoff for penalty language. @legal please flag for review if anyone from legal is watching.

ryan: Finance will stub SKU codes in billing system and spin up a sample test customer. Need a test dataset for metering from eng.

elaine: Thanks all — if no blockers by EOD we'll send the acceptance checklist to execs Monday for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
